description: Daily U.S. airport checkpoint screening counts (how many travelers TSA screened nationwide each day), sourced from the TSA's own published daily figures. Pass a single `date`, a `start_date`/`end_date` range, or a `year` for the whole year; with nothing, returns the current year to date. Covers 2019-01-01 through roughly yesterday's date in 2026. Returns found:false (not an error) for a date outside that published range. Keyless.
name: tsa_checkpoint_volumes
title: Tsa Checkpoint Volumes
